text: The DRRS Fiji initiative is a targeted expert assignment aimed at addressing flood risk and building resilience in the Ba River catchment area. It is part of a broader intervention led by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency, focusing on identifying and mobilizing financing for flood risk reduction. The initiative integrates financing strategies with technical flood risk analysis and institutional capacity assessments to close critical financing gaps in Fiji, aligning with the country's climate and disaster risk finance agenda.
